KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.

2. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

3. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.

4. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. pana
   B. nene
   C. zito
   D. fupi

5. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

6. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

7. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.

8. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.

9. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. mato
   C. watoto
   D. kitoto

10. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain nyakati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Usalama and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Maagano and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
